Decision_Question: Which annualization convention, factor, and short-segment treatment should apply to valid contiguous equity segments?
Recommended_Option: Option B: verified-session annualization using 252 intervals per nominal year; annualized metrics only at n>=252 consecutive valid one-session returns; keep short segments unannualized; RF/MAR remain separately specified.
Alternative_Options: Option A: unannualized reporting only. Option C: calendar-time annualization using 365.25 days and explicit time-scaling assumptions.

Decision_Question: Which of the five proposed snapshot/version identifiers, if any, should be mandatory, and at what interface level?
Recommended_Option: Option B: approve all five as distinct mandatory run/snapshot lineage references, not all as daily optimizer arguments; retain Risk_Data_Hash as separately required.
Alternative_Options: Option A: require all five on every allocator interface call. Option C: keep all five pending until interface design is finalized.
